title: Collection of 9/11 precognitive dreams

tellings.quote: when the 9/11 World Trade Center disaster occurred in New York it occurred to me that this would be a fantastic research opportunity so with within 3 days I had posters up in Washington Square um and I ran a series of ads in the Village Voice um asking did you dream of the World Trade Center and I have a collection of more than 75 dreams that people sent me

plain: A scientist named Rupert Sheldrake told podcast host Jesse Michels that when the World Trade Center was attacked in New York in 2001, he saw a chance to study dreams that seem to foresee the future. He says that within three days he had posters up in Washington Square and ads in the Village Voice, a New York weekly paper, asking whether people had dreamed of the towers, and that he now has more than 75 such dreams people sent him. If the dreams are what they seem, it would suggest people can sense events before they happen.
